name: Giant Defy Advanced SL 1
why_interesting: Exact-trim public notes and a current official 2026 reference establish the higher-tier Defy Advanced SL 1 separately from the existing Defy Advanced 2 candidate.
missing: Map the public-post bikes to the referenced 2026 official generation and reconcile the seatpost descriptions
Confirm the community-reported 7.4 kg complete weight with official or measured evidence
Current mainland CNY price, stock, purchase route and warranty

facts.drivetrain: 2026 official reference: SRAM Force AXS E1 electronic 2×12, 46/33 and 10-36
facts.brakes: 2026 official reference: SRAM Force E1 hydraulic disc, 160 mm
facts.frame: 2026 official reference: Advanced SL-grade composite with integrated seatpost
facts.frame_material: 2026 official global trim: Advanced SL-grade Composite frame and full-composite OverDrive Aero steerer; the exact fiber supplier and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: Integrated seatpost and full-composite OverDrive Aero steerer on the 2026 official global trim; mapping the community bike to this generation remains unresolved
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or generation-bound exact-SL1 stiffness result was found; community ride impressions are not attached because the post does not establish the 2026 frame/build mapping
facts.sizes: S, M, M/L and L on the referenced UK page
facts.complete_weight_status: Community-reported 7.4 kg remains unverified and unmapped after 50 registered source areas
facts.price_status: No attributable current mainland CNY amount found after 50 registered source areas

support_note: Giant provides an official mainland dealer locator and warranty policy; neither establishes current Defy Advanced SL 1 stock or price.
source_note: The current 2026 global trim remains a reference only. Giant explicitly declines a universal complete-bike weight; the community 7.4 kg report is not generation-, size- or configuration-mapped. No current mainland CNY amount was established after 50 registered areas.
